intro:
Design leader with over 12 years of experience driving innovation and results for Scandinavian and Silicon Valley startups as well as Wall Street enterprises, including multiple IP-protected solutions.
Proven track record of leading high-performing design teams with a strategic, outcome-focused approach—balancing clear direction with autonomy and structured checkpoints to ensure project success.
Known for cultivating open, collaborative cultures within cross-functional teams, with a strong emphasis on aligning user experience with measurable business impact.
